antenna_keepout_mm.purpose: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 antenna access: no copper pour, tracks, or tall parts; keep clear on all copper layers. ASSUMED reservation, not a measured native polygon: the 10 native copper-pour keepouts include no antenna keepout. RF certification itself is out of scope.

functional_copper: none: starting board carries no tracks, vias, zones, or pours
manufacturer_layout_rules: see harness-lab/blocks/mcu/identity-inventory.json manufacturer_layout_rules; numeric enforcement ships in U3

mcu_region_mm.purpose: MCU module + decoupling/EN/boot/I2C pullups + routing access

HV.note: Mains-referenced / switched power. DC_BUS_RTN (dc_bus_minus) and PWR_RTN (power_return, doubler midpoint) are HV per elec/domain_manifest.yaml, not SELV returns. Isolation barrier to SELV required across every copper layer; a declared boundary or distance check alone is not a barrier (CONCEPTS.md).

SELV_LV.note: Aux 15V from PS1 (IRM-10-15, isolated) feeds buck VIN; buck 3V3 feeds MCU VCC3V3. gnd and PWR_RTN are separate compiled nets (star-join short removed); the single LV return tie claim for this section is a U2 wiring obligation, not a measured board fact.

signal.note: SELV-referenced control/sense. No new HV/LV crossing is introduced by this section.
